evals.prompt: revfactory/harness README_KO.md를 보고 우리 프로젝트에 맞는 코드 리뷰 팀 하네스를 구성해줘.
evals.expected_output: Audit the project first, identify the source-specific factory and required host capabilities, and propose the smallest supported team before approved writes.
assertions: Uses revfactory-harness rather than harness2 benchmarks
Inspects existing agents, skills, and CLAUDE.md and avoids duplicate roles
Checks actual session tools and budget before native execution

evals.prompt: Install the jeo-skills revfactory-harness guide globally; do not activate any Claude plugins.
evals.expected_output: Preview then install only the catalog guide using the existing router, with upstream registration left untouched.
assertions: Separates router installation from marketplace/plugin installation
Does not clone upstream, activate plugins, call models, or generate project files

evals.prompt: Install harness@harness-marketplace from this checkout, but ~/.claude/skills/harness already belongs to another tool.
evals.expected_output: Preflight the source and collisions, preserve foreign files, choose one approved installation mode, and verify actual plugin loading.
assertions: Does not overwrite or merge the existing harness directory or a shared-root symlink
Verifies the audited pin and public-file hashes
Does not install both plugin and direct-copy modes

evals.prompt: Use revfactory/harness Workflow to fan out 50 tasks; this session has no Workflow tool.
evals.expected_output: Report the missing native capability as a blocker instead of fabricating an API or silently selecting a different execution mode.
assertions: Reports Workflow as unavailable and does not invoke it
Does not silently substitute Agent APIs or assume the fable alias exists
Requires an explicit supported mode and budget before execution

evals.prompt: revfactory v1 하네스에 TeamCreate와 실험 플래그가 남아 있어. v2로 옮겨줘.
evals.expected_output: Audit legacy constructs and actual replacement capabilities; preview scoped changes and test a real supported path after approval.
assertions: Uses the pinned migration reference and preserves user history and _workspace
Does not enable CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS as a workaround
Does not claim upstream API-removal statements prove the target host's API contract

evals.prompt: 지난번 revfactory 팀 실행에서 검증자가 불확실하다고 했는데 통과 처리됐어. /harness:evolve로 고쳐줘.
evals.expected_output: Collect the actual failed output and before/after delta, change the verdict handling rather than inventing missing evidence, and retest one cause.
assertions: Uses evolve for adjusting an existing team, not silently adding new roles
Keeps uncertain and missing results unresolved rather than passed
Records actual comparison evidence and change history

evals.prompt: The revfactory upstream preflight passed. Tell the team our plugin and multi-agent execution are now fully verified.
evals.expected_output: Limit the claim to offline checks and name the plugin-loading, authentication, runtime-capability, and executed-task evidence still missing.
assertions: Keeps runtime_verified false for the offline helper
Does not claim live plugin execution or reproduce v1 A/B gains as its own results

evals.prompt: Run google-research/harness2's local demo, then budget a LAB benchmark.
evals.expected_output: Route to harness2 and preserve its benchmark-specific approvals, not the revfactory plugin.
assertions: Routes to harness2
Does not install revfactory/harness or restore the retired catalog harness directory

evals.prompt: Validate this SKILL.md frontmatter and synchronize its catalog projections; I do not need a team factory.
evals.expected_output: Route to skill-standardization for standalone authoring and structural validation.
assertions: Routes to skill-standardization
Does not register a Claude marketplace or generate agents

evals.prompt: Start a Ruflo hive-mind swarm in this repository.
evals.expected_output: Route to ruflo for that runtime and its initialization/permission boundaries.
assertions: Routes to ruflo
Does not treat revfactory-harness as a swarm runtime or harness2 alias
